name: Northwind Bakery
tagline: Slow mornings start with something warm.
description: Small batch bread, laminated pastries, and coffee baked fresh for Harbor Hollow each morning.

services.name: Country loaves
services.description: Naturally leavened bread with a dark crust and soft crumb.

services.name: Morning pastry
services.description: Croissants, morning buns, and seasonal fruit danishes.

services.name: Celebration cakes
services.description: Small custom cakes with simple finishes and bright flavors.

services.name: Coffee counter
services.description: Espresso, pour over coffee, tea, and house made syrups.

services.name: Lunch bakes
services.description: Savory hand pies, focaccia slices, and fresh soup.

services.name: Weekend boxes
services.description: A rotating pastry box for pickup on Saturday and Sunday.

reviews.author: Maya R.
reviews.quote: The rye loaf has a deep crust and stays tender for days. The counter team remembered my order on my second visit.

reviews.author: Theo B.
reviews.quote: Come early for the pear danish. The pastry is crisp, the filling is bright, and the coffee is excellent.

reviews.author: Nina K.
reviews.quote: They made a small birthday cake that looked clean, tasted fresh, and felt right for the occasion.
